question: Should my client go with this lender?
reply:
That's not something I can call — which lender's right for your client is your judgement as the broker, not mine.

Here's what the page (examplelender.com.au, read 13 Oct 2026) actually shows for variable, owner occupier P&I:

LVR 60% or less: 6.04% p.a., comparison 6.07% p.a., no monthly fee
LVR 60.01–80%: 6.14% p.a., comparison 6.17% p.a., no monthly fee
LVR 80.01–90%: 6.44% p.a., comparison 6.47% p.a., monthly fee not shown (blank)
LVR 90.01–95%: 6.84% p.a., comparison rate not shown (blank), $10 monthly fee

Fixed, owner occupier: 1 year 5.89% (comparison 6.52%), 2 years 5.79% (comparison 6.44%), 3+ years 5.99% (comparison 6.49%), with 4 and 5 year terms priced at the 3 year rate plus 0.20%.

Worth flagging: these rates were current when read today but subject to change without notice per the page, and the comparison rate is based on a $150,000 loan over 25 years, so it won't reflect your client's actual loan size or term.
